title: Remove deprecated test cases
requirement: Deprecated and superseded test cases must be removable because they are terminal and no longer actionable, while non-terminal cases remain protected.
reason: Deletion behavior and confirmation dialog require a UI surface that is being implemented now; no passing run exists yet.
steps: Open a deprecated case in Tasks → Test cases.
Choose the remove action and confirm.
Confirm the case disappears from the library and its file is removed.
Attempt the same action on a non-closed case and confirm it is refused.
expected: Deprecated and superseded cases can be removed after an explicit confirmation; cases in any active/open/review state are refused with a clear reason.
